text: Given the decision to upgrade irrigation systems, I recommend the "kit the crew can lay before the dry month" as the optimal choice. This option offers both significant cost savings and practical benefits that align with the farm's immediate needs without compromising reliability or speed. By utilizing this kit, the team will be able to install new irrigation systems efficiently just prior to the onset of dry conditions, ensuring minimal downtime in water availability. This proactive measure significantly reduces disruptions and ensures ongoing productivity throughout the growing season.
